description: Publish a message posted in an announcement channel (type 5) so Discord copies it into every channel that follows that channel. Use it after posting with discord_send_message in an announcement channel; regular text channels cannot be crossposted, and a message can be published only once, so a second call fails. Manage Messages is only needed for messages the bot did not send. Returns the published message. Bot permissions it may need: View Channel, Send Messages, Manage Messages. Changes Discord data and is not idempotent; check the result before retrying.

channel_id.description: ID of the announcement channel (type 5) that holds the message

message_id.description: ID of the message to publish to following channels
